description: Store DataFrames as Parquet files on the local filesystem (dev / no-warehouse).

resource_key.description: Dagster resource key for this IO manager. Use 'io_manager' to make it the default.
resource_key.label: Resource Key

base_dir.description: Local directory under which to store assets, e.g. '/tmp/dagster_data'.
base_dir.label: Base Directory

create_dir.description: Create base_dir if it doesn't exist.
create_dir.label: Create Directory

backend.description: 'pandas' or 'polars'. 'polars' reads/writes via DataFrame.write_parquet/pl.read_parquet directly -- not through the dagster-polars package, so it isn't affected by that package's Polars 2.0 incompatibility (community-integrations#359).
backend.label: Backend

name: LocalParquetIOManager
